name: Rating
summary: A score out of N: given by the person, or shown as others gave it.

value.description: The score in host data; written when the person can rate

readOnly.description: Show a score rather than take one

count.description: How many ratings the score is from, shown after it: '4.6 (212)'

action.description: Runs when a rating is given, with context bound to value

whenToUse: Asking how something went, out of five
Showing a product's or place's rating with the count behind it
whenNotToUse: A number within bounds that isn't a score: use RangeInput
Yes or no: use Toggle or Choice

accessibility.role: radiogroup of radios named '1 star' to 'N stars' when it can be given; an image named '4.6 out of 5' when read-only
requirements: Every star is a real control at size.target.min when the person can rate
The current value is announced; half values are said as such
Read-only ratings carry the score as text, not only as filled shapes

agent: Reads the score and the count; sets a score by choosing '<n> stars'.
rendering: Filled shapes use color.status.warning.emphasis; empty ones use color.border.default
The readout ('4.6') is shown after the shapes in tabular figures, with the count in color.text.muted
A rating that can be given shows the label above, like every input
